# Ajay Sachdev
> Finance & Operations Manager at a B2B tech scale-up. CIMA finalist (Strategic Case Study sat May 2026). Builds production AI systems, Power BI dashboards, and financial models. Python, TypeScript, SQL. Based in Cambridge, UK.

## Background
- Sindhi family from Mumbai; grew up in the family textile business (est. 1988)
- Bachelor in Financial Markets, Jai Hind College, Mumbai (2015-18)
- M.Com (Year 1), University of Mumbai
- Diploma in Weaving Technology, Sasmira, Mumbai
- Chartered Wealth Management (AAFM, 2019)
- MSc Finance, Loughborough University (2020-21, 2:1)
- CIMA finalist: Strategic Case Study sat May 2026
- Joined a B2B tech scale-up in October 2021; now sole finance & ops function across UK, US, Pakistan
- School Governor at a 250-pupil primary school

## Projects
- OpsPilot: AI executive assistant in Microsoft Teams. 97,000 lines, 28 AI tools, 6,124+ documents indexed, 100% search accuracy on a 50-query suite. In production 24/7. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/ajay-brain.html
- Trading Bot: FTSE 100 intraday system with four AI agents and an absolute-veto risk auditor. 7,000+ lines. Paper trading: 62 sessions, zero impulsive trades let through. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/trading-bot.html
- Uni-Nation Digital (uni-nation.in): website, inventory PWA (~22,000 lines) and Hindi voice stock entry for the family fabric business. Roughly $2m of sales data, ~2,000 products, 650+ customers. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/uni-nation.html
- WhatsApp Smart: Chrome extension prototype adding scheduling, AI replies and summaries to WhatsApp Web. 10 features built, privacy-first, unreleased. Case study: https://ajaysachdev.com/projects/whatsapp-smart.html
- SCS Cockpit: zero-dependency study engine built to prepare for his own CIMA case study. 4,200 lines

## Key Metrics
- Board-level financial models and reporting
- 50+ Power BI dashboards built
- 7 multi-currency bank accounts managed (GBP, USD, PKR)

- 40+ hours/month saved through automation
- WiFi costs reduced 50%, electricity 74%, software 30%+
- Core SaaS platform cost cut 65% through a systematic audit
- Redesigned contracts from 15 pages to 2; six-month stalls became one-week signings
